description: 1. The agent reads SKILL.md and discovers the local resources at `skills/changelog-curator/`. 2. It reads `spec.json` to learn commit classification rules (user_facing: feat/fix/perf/security/deprecate; internal: chore/refactor/test/ci/build/style/docs-internal; ambiguous: revert/merge/bump) and the critical rule that commits with missing scope must be listed under '待确认项'. 3. It parses the raw messy text in `project/docs/raw_v2.4.0_commits.txt` and constructs a structured JSON input file conforming to the spec's expected schema (version, date, commits list, known_limitations, compatibility, upgrade_guide). 4. It invokes `python3 skills/changelog-curator/scripts/run.py --input <prepared_json> --output changelog_v2.4.0.md`. 5. The output file must: (a) have the exact header format `## [2.4.0] - 2025-07-18`; (b) contain all 6 required sections plus '待确认项'; (c) correctly route user-facing commits (feat/fix/perf/security/deprecate with scopes) to '用户可感知变化'; (d) correctly route internal commits to '内部改进'; (e) route the two scope-less commits (refactor middleware, feat global timeout) and ambiguous-type commits (revert/merge/bump/unknown) to '待确认项'; (f) include the breaking change (/v1/legacy-export removal) in '兼容性注意'; (g) include both known limitations; (h) produce bullets in the `- [type(scope)] message` format characteristic of run.py output.
